name: Input Buffer
description: Practice training wheels: a hidden ghost predicts your click and moves early clicks (and wave releases) to the first tick that survives.

prediction-horizon.name: Prediction distance (ticks)
prediction-horizon.description: How far ahead the ghost checks for a death after your input. 240 ticks = 1 second. Longer catches deaths further away but can flag deaths you'd have fixed with a later click.

practice-only.name: Practice mode only
practice-only.description: Only buffer inputs while in practice mode, so normal-mode runs stay legit.

show-label.name: Show in-game label
show-label.description: Show the current stage and live tick counter in the top-left corner while playing.

debug-log.name: Debug log
debug-log.description: Print prediction details to the console: inputs with no safe timing, and how closely the ghost's prediction matched what really happened.
